en.title: Assessment Report of an FAO Fishing Area
en.description:
This function runs the analyses of the package for one FAO major fishing area and writes a
Word report in Chinese or English: cover, title, abstract, data sources and methods, results
and conclusions with charts and tables, references and appendix tables. The text is written
from templates filled in with the results, as a first draft: check it, and complete the parts
marked in grey, such as other data sources, the discussion and other references.
en.details:
Every analysis is a section that can be switched on or off (`total`, `species`, ...,
`cmsy`). The settings of the function of a section are given with the section name as
prefix, e.g. `species_h_value = 0.2` is `h_value = 0.2` of `fishing_area_species()` and
`cmsy_top = 5` is `top = 5` of `cmsy_area()`. The abstract, the methods, the conclusions and
the references follow the sections that are switched on.

Chinese reports follow the format of project reports: A4 pages; body text in FangSong and
Times New Roman, size 12 (xiao si), 1.5 line spacing and a first-line indent of two
characters; title in bold FangSong, size 18; "abstract" in SimHei, size 15; section headings
in SimHei and subsection headings in KaiTi, size 14; captions in SimHei, size 12, numbered by
report (figure 1-1, table 1-1), below figures and above tables; three-line tables with text
in FangSong, size 10.5; numbered references in superscript square brackets, in the order of
citation (GB/T 7714). English reports have the same structure, in one font (Arial by
default), with author-date citations in APA style or in the style of FAO publications.
Scientific names of species and genera are in italics.

The text templates are in `inst/extdata/report_text.csv` and the references in
`inst/extdata/report_references.csv` of the package source: edit them to change the wording.
en.value:
Invisibly, a list of class `fao_report` with the path of the Word file (`file`), the
sections in the report (`sections`) and
the tables of the report as data frames: `main_species` and `main_countries`, the
species of the mean temperature of the catch with their FishBase matches
(`mtc_species`), the results of all analyses (`analyses`), and with
CMSY++ `cmsy_reference_points` (r, k, MSY, Fmsy, Bmsy, B/Bmsy and F/Fmsy with 95%
confidence limits), `cmsy_priors` (resilience, r, k and B/k priors, their sources and
the links to FishBase or SeaLifeBase, the FishBase data, the CMSY++ code and the FAO
data) and the full CMSY++ result `cmsy`. Assign it, e.g. `report <- fao_report(...)`,
to look at the tables (`View(report$cmsy_priors)`). With `cmsy = TRUE`, all CMSY++
results (runs, charts and tables) are kept in the folder `cmsy/` next to the report,
with `cmsy_result.rds` to write the report again without running CMSY++
(`cmsy = readRDS("cmsy/<area>/cmsy_result.rds")`).

arguments.area:
The FAO major fishing area: its name, e.g. "Atlantic, Eastern Central", or its
code, e.g. 34.
Settings of the analyses, named with the section as prefix: `total_` for
`fishing_area_data()`, `species_` for `fishing_area_species()`, `countries_` for
`fishing_area_country()`, `groups_` for `species_group_composition()`, `status_` for
`stock_status()`, `quality_` for `data_quality()`, `diversity_` for
`diversity_concentration()`, `fleets_` for `coastal_distant()`, `shocks_` for
`catch_shocks()`, `collapse_` for `collapse_analysis()` (and `collapse_seed`, the seed of
its random series, default 1), `synchrony_` for `catch_synchrony()`, `pelagic_` for
`pelagic_demersal()`, `mtc_` for `mean_temperature_catch()` (the report uses
`mtc_version = "builtin"`, the FishBase data bundled with the package, unless another
version is given), `distant_` for `distant_water_profile()` (and `distant_countries`,
the number of distant-water countries profiled, default 3, or their names) and
`cmsy_` for `cmsy_area()` (and `cmsy_input()`). For example `species_h_value = 0.2`,
`countries_line_linewidth = 1`, `status_smooth = TRUE`, `cmsy_top = 5` or
`cmsy_settings = list(n.iter = 100000)`. A name that is not an argument of the
function gives an error listing its arguments. The arguments the report sets itself
(`area_data`, `area_name`, `area`, `lang`, `table` and `pptx`) cannot be changed.
arguments.file:
The Word file to write. Default is `reports/FAO<code>_report_<lang>.docx` in the
working directory.
arguments.lang:
The language of the report: "zh" (Chinese) or "en" (English). Default is NULL,
the language set with `fao_settings()` ("both" gives a Chinese report).
arguments.title:
The report title. Default is generated from the area, e.g. "Assessment of
Marine Capture Production in FAO Major Fishing Area 34 (Atlantic, Eastern Central)".
arguments.report_no:
The number of the report, shown as "Report 1" (in Chinese reports with a
Chinese numeral) and used in the figure and table numbers (1-1, 1-2, ...). Default is 1.
arguments.author:
The author on the cover and below the title. Default is NULL, which writes
"Author" ("作者" in Chinese reports) as a placeholder.
arguments.affiliation: The affiliation on the cover. Default is NULL, none.
arguments.project:
The text at the top of the cover. Default is NULL, which writes "Project Report"
("课题报告" in Chinese reports).
arguments.date: The date on the cover. Default is today.
arguments.font:
The font of the text in Latin script. Default is "Times New Roman" in Chinese
reports and "Arial" in English reports.
arguments.font_zh: The font of the Chinese body text. Default is "FangSong".
arguments.citation:
The citation style of English reports: "apa" (default) or "fao" (the style
of FAO publications). Chinese reports use numbered citations (GB/T 7714).
arguments.top_n:
The number of main species and countries in the charts and tables, and of
species assessed with CMSY++ (unless `cmsy_top` is given). Default is 10.
arguments.data_version: The FAO release to use, as in `load_fao_data()`. Default is "latest".
arguments.total, species, countries, groups, statu:
Logical values: whether
the report has the section on the total catch and its stages (`fishing_area_data()`),
the main species (`fishing_area_species()`), the main fishing countries
(`fishing_area_country()`), the ISSCAAP groups (`species_group_composition()`), the
stock status plots (`stock_status()`), the data quality (`data_quality()`), the
diversity and concentration of the catch (`diversity_concentration()`) and the
coastal and distant-water fleets (`coastal_distant()`). All TRUE by default.
arguments.shocks, collapse, synchrony, pelagic, mt:
Logical values: whether the report has
the sections on catch shocks (`catch_shocks()`), fishery collapses
(`collapse_analysis()`), the synchrony of the catch and the portfolio effect
(`catch_synchrony()`), the pelagic to demersal ratio (`pelagic_demersal()`), the mean
temperature of the catch (`mean_temperature_catch()`) and the profiles of the main
distant-water fleets in the area (`distant_water_profile()`). All FALSE by default.
arguments.cmsy:
A logical value. If TRUE, the main species are also assessed with CMSY++
(`cmsy_area()`), and the report has a part on the assessment, with the results of
every species and appendix tables of the reference points, priors and their sources.
Default is FALSE. The result of an earlier `cmsy_area()` run can also be given, to
write the report without running CMSY++ again. CMSY++ needs JAGS: see `cmsy_setup()`.

zh.title: FAO渔区评估报告
zh.description: 该函数对一个FAO主要渔区运行本包的各项分析，并生成中文或英文的Word报告：封面、标题、摘要、数据来源与分析方法、结果与结论（含图表和表格）、参考文献和附表。报告文字由模板填入分析结果生成，是一份初稿：请核对文字，并补充以灰色标出的部分，如其他数据来源、讨论和其他参考文献。
zh.details:
每项分析是报告中的一个章节，可以单独开启或关闭（`total`、`species`……`cmsy`）。章节所用函数的设置以章节名作为前缀传入，例如`species_h_value = 0.2`即`fishing_area_species()`的`h_value = 0.2`，`cmsy_top = 5`即`cmsy_area()`的`top = 5`。摘要、分析方法、结论和参考文献随开启的章节而变化。

中文报告采用课题报告的格式：A4纸；正文中文为仿宋、西文为Times New Roman，小四号（12磅），1.5倍行距，首行缩进2字符；标题为仿宋加粗，小二号（18磅）；“摘要”为黑体，小三号（15磅）；一级标题为黑体、二级标题为楷体，均为四号（14磅）；题注为黑体，小四号（12磅），按报告编号（图1-1、表1-1），图题在图下方，表题在表上方；三线表，表内文字为仿宋，五号（10.5磅）；参考文献按引用顺序编号，正文中以上标方括号标注（GB/T 7714）。英文报告结构相同，只用一种字体（默认为Arial），采用APA格式或FAO出版物格式的著者-出版年制引文。物种和属的学名用斜体。

报告的文字模板位于本包源代码的`inst/extdata/report_text.csv`，参考文献位于`inst/extdata/report_references.csv`：修改这些文件即可更改措辞。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个`fao_report`类的列表，包含Word文件的路径（`file`）、报告中包含的章节（`sections`），以及报告中以数据框形式给出的表格：`main_species`（主要物种）和`main_countries`（主要捕捞国家），渔获平均温度所用的物种及其FishBase匹配结果（`mtc_species`），全部分析的结果（`analyses`）；有CMSY++评估时，还包括`cmsy_reference_points`（r、k、MSY、Fmsy、Bmsy、B/Bmsy和F/Fmsy及其95%置信限）、`cmsy_priors`（恢复力、r、k和B/k先验及其来源，以及指向FishBase或SeaLifeBase、FishBase数据、CMSY++代码和FAO数据的链接）和完整的CMSY++结果`cmsy`。将结果赋值给一个变量，例如`report <- fao_report(...)`，即可查看这些表格（`View(report$cmsy_priors)`）。`cmsy = TRUE`时，CMSY++的全部结果（各次运行、图表和表格）保存在报告旁边的`cmsy/`文件夹中，其中的`cmsy_result.rds`可用于不再运行CMSY++而重新生成报告（`cmsy = readRDS("cmsy/<area>/cmsy_result.rds")`）。

arguments.area: FAO主要渔区：名称（例如"Atlantic, Eastern Central"）或代码（例如34）。
各项分析的设置，以章节名作为前缀命名：`total_`对应`fishing_area_data()`，`species_`对应`fishing_area_species()`，`countries_`对应`fishing_area_country()`，`groups_`对应`species_group_composition()`，`status_`对应`stock_status()`，`quality_`对应`data_quality()`，`diversity_`对应`diversity_concentration()`，`fleets_`对应`coastal_distant()`，`shocks_`对应`catch_shocks()`，`collapse_`对应`collapse_analysis()`（另有`collapse_seed`，即其随机序列的随机数种子，默认为1），`synchrony_`对应`catch_synchrony()`，`pelagic_`对应`pelagic_demersal()`，`mtc_`对应`mean_temperature_catch()`（除非指定了其他版本，报告使用`mtc_version = "builtin"`，即本包自带的FishBase数据），`distant_`对应`distant_water_profile()`（另有`distant_countries`，即要介绍的远洋捕捞国数量，默认为3，即近5年在该渔区远洋渔获量最大的3个国家；也可以给出这些国家的英文名称），`cmsy_`对应`cmsy_area()`（以及`cmsy_input()`）。例如`species_h_value = 0.2`、`countries_line_linewidth = 1`、`status_smooth = TRUE`、`cmsy_top = 5`或`cmsy_settings = list(n.iter = 100000)`。如果某个名称不是对应函数的参数，会报错并列出该函数的参数。报告自行设定的参数（`area_data`、`area_name`、`area`、`lang`、`table`和`pptx`）不能通过前缀更改。
arguments.file: 要写入的Word文件。默认为工作目录下的`reports/FAO<code>_report_<lang>.docx`。
arguments.lang: 报告的语言："zh"（中文）或"en"（英文）。默认为NULL，即使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（"both"生成中文报告）。
arguments.title: 报告标题。默认根据渔区生成，例如"FAO 34渔区（中东大西洋）海洋捕捞产量评估"（英文报告为"Assessment of Marine Capture Production in FAO Major Fishing Area 34 (Atlantic, Eastern Central)"）。
arguments.report_no: 报告编号，显示为"报告一"（中文报告使用汉字数字；英文报告为"Report 1"），并用于图和表格的编号（1-1、1-2……）。默认为1。
arguments.author: 封面和标题下方的作者。默认为NULL，此时写入占位文字"作者"（英文报告为"Author"）。
arguments.affiliation: 封面上的单位。默认为NULL，即不写单位。
arguments.project: 封面顶部的文字。默认为NULL，此时写入"课题报告"（英文报告为"Project Report"）。
arguments.date: 封面上的日期。默认为当天。
arguments.font: 拉丁字母文字（西文和数字）的字体；英文报告的全部文字都使用该字体。默认中文报告为"Times New Roman"，英文报告为"Arial"。
arguments.font_zh: 中文正文的字体（也用于标题、表格和参考文献；各级标题和题注使用黑体和楷体）。默认为"FangSong"（仿宋）。
arguments.citation: 英文报告的引文格式："apa"（默认）或"fao"（FAO出版物的格式）。中文报告使用顺序编码制引文（GB/T 7714）。
arguments.top_n: 图表和表格中主要物种和国家的数量，以及用CMSY++评估的物种数（未指定`cmsy_top`时）。默认为10。
arguments.total, species, countries, groups, statu: 逻辑值：报告是否包含以下章节：总渔获量及其阶段划分（`fishing_area_data()`）、主要物种（`fishing_area_species()`）、主要捕捞国家（`fishing_area_country()`）、ISSCAAP物种类群（`species_group_composition()`）、资源状态图（`stock_status()`）、数据质量（`data_quality()`）、渔获量的多样性与集中度（`diversity_concentration()`），以及沿岸国与远洋捕捞国（`coastal_distant()`）。默认均为TRUE。
arguments.shocks, collapse, synchrony, pelagic, mt: 逻辑值：报告是否包含以下章节：渔获骤变（`catch_shocks()`）、渔业崩溃（`collapse_analysis()`）、渔获量的同步性与组合效应（`catch_synchrony()`）、中上层/底层比（`pelagic_demersal()`）、渔获平均温度（`mean_temperature_catch()`），以及该渔区主要远洋捕捞国的概况（`distant_water_profile()`）。默认均为FALSE。
arguments.cmsy: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，还会用CMSY++（`cmsy_area()`）评估主要物种，报告中增加资源评估部分，包括每个物种的结果，以及生物学参考点、先验及其来源的附表。默认为FALSE。也可以传入之前`cmsy_area()`运行的结果，这样无需再次运行CMSY++即可生成报告。CMSY++需要JAGS：见`cmsy_setup()`。
